resources.string: The username or password is not right. Check them and try again.
Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
This account is not allowed to do that.
You are not on the list for this activity. Ask your faculty member to add you.
We could not find that. Pull down to refresh and try again.
Your face photo has not been approved yet. Faculty must approve it before you can check in.
This activity is not open for that action right now. Check the activity times.
That step is not available yet, or you have already done it. Refresh the activity to see what is next.
There is no open checkpoint right now, or you have already answered this one.
Faculty has already made a decision on this photo.
This attempt ran out of time. You can start again.
The photo is too large to send. Take it again.
Something was missing from the request. Please try again.
We could not use that photo. Hold the phone at eye level, face the light, keep your face in the frame, and retake it.
This is not the same person as the enrolled photo. Nothing was recorded.
More than one face was in the photo. Make sure only you are in the frame, then retake it.
Your location reading was too old. We are getting a fresh one.
This version of the app is too old to sign in. Install the latest FieldPass app.
Your account is linked to a different phone. Ask your faculty to reset your phone on the dashboard, then sign in again.
This phone is already linked to another student. Each student must use their own phone.
This phone could not prove the check-in came from it. Sign out, sign in again, and try once more.
Cannot reach FieldPass. Check your Wi-Fi or hotspot, then try again.
The server took too long to answer. Your request may or may not have arrived. Try again.
The server had a problem. Please try again in a moment.
This build is not connected to a valid FieldPass server. Ask the organizer for an updated app.
This is a faculty account. Please use the faculty dashboard in a web browser. This app is for students.
Location permission is off. FieldPass reads your location only while you check in, answer a checkpoint or check out.
Location services are turned off on this phone. Turn them on, then try again.
We could not get a location reading in time. Move to an open area if you can, then try again.
Camera permission is off. FieldPass uses the camera only to take your photo.
The camera could not take a photo. Please try again.
Something went wrong. Please try again.
